title: Declare how a reusable child behaves inside a cached section
goal: Keep request-aware components live or refuse subtree capture unless the enclosing static SSR cache declares the required variation, accounting for captured parameter replay.

selectionNotes: Static SSR GET capture; Rerender runs lifecycle with parameters replayed unchanged.
Throw refuses capture after child initialization; never use it to prevent lifecycle side effects.
